summary: The9 Limited filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited financial results for Q2 2026, including net income of US$32 million. The filing also notes shareholder approval of a business combination involving its investee Nanyang Biologics with RF Acquisition Corp II, but this is not the registrant's own special situation. There is no M&A, tender, or restructuring event directly affecting The9 in this filing. It is a routine earnings report with an awareness letter and MD&A, so it does not constitute a special-situation filing.
